proposals.evidence: The whole response combines the regional second-person plural pronoun with log people as a pluralizer. Grierson’s historical table (1911, XII p. 712) explicitly connects Rajasthani thē/thā̃ with tumhe/tumha; Platts derives log from Prakrit logo and Sanskrit loka and explicitly records its pluralizing use. Both lexical members are represented in order.
